Critical risks 1. A shared fix can become a global CSS leak. Require root scoped se
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — critique and execution the awtsmoos renews every visible vessel before the eye can name its form; awtsmoos.com is remembered where gevurah tests every glow so polished motion becomes a norm. critical risks 1. a shared fix can become a global css leak. require root scoped selectors and explicit imports. 2. replacing native controls can damage accessibility. preserve semantic elements; replace only visible chrome where necessary. 3. sitewide changes can collide with concurrent dirty work. git status every target immediately before ownership. 4. mobile visual polish can hide content behind fixed layers. runtime geometry checks include fixed layer compensation and short height cases. 5. fancy animation can reduce usability. every motion has reduced motion fallback and active/focus states remain obvious. 6. z index cleanup can break dialogs/popovers. define page local named layers and test actual open states. 7. a source only grep can miss js generated controls. pair source census with browser runtime census. 8. browser default controls differ by os. treat visible native audio/video controls as failures regardless of local appearance. 9. styling bare elements globally can create conflicts. never fix a route by adding rootless input, textarea, button, audio, or wildcard rules. 10. a one off social hub fix can fail to propagate to private messages/social pulse. trace shared components and fix the shared ownership boundary where safe. execution waves wave 1 — site census and audit tooling enumerate route/page entries; enumerate native interactive/media elements; identify local style manifests and root selectors; scan global selector leakage, fixed/sticky layers, raw z index hotspots; produce ranked findings. wave 2 — social hub reference remediation trace source that renders message media and composer; replace visible native audio chrome with a reusable scoped media player; fully style composer/input/textarea/labels and all interaction states; fix fixed/sticky geometry and short height behavior; verify home, social pulse, private messages, and any shared conversation surfaces. wave 3 — high risk route clusters prioritize pages with native audio/video, forms, dialogs, fixed ui, old inline styles, or missing viewport metadata. fix by shared scoped primitives only when actual reuse is proven. wave 4 — public apps and games audit each public route at desktop, 390x844, 320x568, and short height. include media, hud, dialogs, drawers, forms, menus, labels, empty states, and errors. wave 5 — utilities/admin/tooling bring remaining utility surfaces under the same ownership contract without destabilizing functional/debug flows. wave 6 — permanent regression gate add source/runtime checks that fail on reintroduced visible native media controls, accidental x overflow, undersized controls, unscoped local selectors, and unresolved audit exceptions. first files to touch not yet guessed. the census must identify social hub's actual source/style modules and their git ownership. new modules are preferred over bloating shared files. existing files are rewritten in full only after imports, callsites, tests, and runtime contracts are read. verification gate a remediated page is not complete until: no document x overflow; no visible viewport escaped actionable control; no unintended overlap in tested states; no raw browser media chrome on branded routes; form controls visibly belong to the page; hover/active/focus visible/disabled states are intentional; reduced motion behavior is present; phone targets are =44px where practical; open dialogs/drawers/menus remain bounded and scrollable; browser console/runtime errors are empty for the exercised path.

excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He REMAINING WORK — Sitewide UI Audit The Awtsmoos renews every route until no unfinished garment can hide beneath a polished shell; Awtsmoos.com turns discovery into ownership, ownership into correction, and correction into proof that can tell. searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he remaining work — sitewide ui audit the awtsmoos renews every route until no unfinished garment can hide beneath a polished shell; awtsmoos.com turns discovery into ownership, ownership into correction, and correction into proof that can tell. closed evidence whole site census identified 228 html/page entries plus native media, form, overlay, z index, and partially styled risk clusters. social hub communication media/composer surfaces were remediated with scoped controls and green source gates. universal chat custom audio/composer work is complete and its local suite passes 26/26. comment thread custom audio/modular contracts are complete and its local suite passes 6/6. rebbe player ownership was traced correctly: playback uses a headless audio object and visible chrome is already custom. rebbe download/playlist runtime stylesheet factories were replaced by static imported modules. rebbe player, playlist selection, and download stack share named layer/clearance tokens rather than five digit z index escalation. rebbe search was decomposed into small panel/template/codec/history/action/fullscreen/result modules; result data uses safe dom and fullscreen uses one bounded shell. rebbe modal init no longer injects close button css; context menus clamp to viewport geometry. rebbe track browser no longer injects runtime css, no longer renders active track ui with executable innerhtml or .onclick =, and now uses safe factories/controllers plus scoped static css. track toolbar action ownership was reviewed and corrected before testing so local select/add/playlist actions cannot double fire controller callbacks. every touched track browser source is 249 lines. any touch requires a full modular split, not a local edit. the studio wave must audit: range controls; color controls; checkboxes; selects; file triggers; textareas; short height/mobile drawer behavior; fixed/sticky collisions; raw z index values; inline/generated styles; hover, active, focus visible, disabled, selected, loading, and reduced motion states. other loaded rebbe layer debt styles/ui.css still contains a raw 9999 layer. styles/boot.css contains 10000. styles/main.css contains several numeric stacking values. index.html contains inline styles for ctx menu and matrix bg; do not touch the large entry file casually because full file rewrite/modular extraction is required. historical root style.css contains many raw layers but is not loaded by the main rebbe entry; treat it as inactive unless another real entry proves otherwise. remaining sitewide native media candidates verify live ownership before mutation: apps/lyric sync/index.html apps/captions/video/index.html apps/video editor/index.html — fresh isolated interaction acceptance still pending ayin/index.html games/emojis/index.html record/index.html recorder/index.html scripts/awtsmoos/social/media/renderasset.js scripts/awtsmoos/tts/ui.js ai/js/chatgpt/audio/audiooffermarkup.js sitewide audit classes still open plain/unowned input, textarea, select, file, range, checkbox, radio, color, audio, and video controls; visually disconnected labels, helper text, error/loading/empty states; dialogs, drawers, popovers, menus, and fullscreen surfaces escaping phone or short height viewports; missing hover, active, focus visible, disabled, selected/pressed, loading, and reduced motion states; accidental horizontal overflow and flex/grid children missing min width:0 / logical containment; sticky/fixed collisions and arbitrary layer escalation; missing viewport/safe area behavior; rootless/global feature css and historical cascade conflicts; controls below a practical 44px mobile touch floor; partially styled regions; public apps/games missing from their correct public indexes. verification law per remediated route inspect real files and git ownership first; full file source rewrites only; touched source <=120 lines, tab indented, readable, and documented; css remains route/subsystem local and statically discoverable; relevant controls own hover/active/focus visible/disabled/reduced motion states; mobile containment and safe area rules are explicit; no new z index war; no visible branded native media chrome where custom ui is intended; existing tests plus new focused regression contracts pass; fresh route load evidence follows source/test closure. next action trace and plan the live rebbe bookshelf subsystem now, then execute its static style/safe dom upgrade before entering the larger studio wave.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — chesed: tree resource realism possibilities the awtsmoos renews root and crown, dry soil and rain; awtsmoos.com can reveal richer growth while one canonical skeleton remains the living chain. high value possibilities explicit pre skeleton resource evidence: soil moisture, fertility, heat stress, soil depth, shade, and site exposure. root versus crown allocation derived before skeleton creation, not retroactively in living metadata. drought should shorten canopy reach, reduce foliage and secondary branching, and bias investment toward trunk/root support. fertile moist sites should permit greater foliage and crown expansion without changing lod identity. shallow soil should restrain height and increase mechanical caution while leaving root anatomy as an additive post skeleton plan. shade should strengthen phototropic seeking and reduce dense inner crown growth. wind exposure should increase gnarliness/mechanical form through the existing force vocabulary, never a second branch system. age and vigor should continue composing with resource evidence rather than being replaced. living.hydraulic remains observational; only explicit environment/development intent may alter canonical structure. geometry detail and lod remain representations of the same skeleton hash. public api stays concise: tree(name, { environment: {...} }) should be sufficient. next action create a focused immutable resource development intent and feed it through the existing treedevelopmentprofile/config path.
